notes.title: New update: Story Mode and Steam Cloud Save!
notes.content:
Hello summer lovers,

To start the school year on the right track, we're coming with an update! We've carefully read your feedback and tried to respond the best we can with an update and a few guides. We've added the Steam Cloud Save, and a "story mode" where you can't instant-win the combat!

Steam Cloud Save

During combat, an instant win button

During combat, a new pop-up

Fixed/Balancing

Increased the amount of relationship points gained to unlock relationship episodes more easily

Main content videos unlocked in the gallery app

Updated credits text

Removed some extra text for some sentences in the Brazilian language

notes.title: Nova Hearts in Lovecraftian Days
notes.content:
Wait, why is Nova Hearts participating in the Lovecraftian Days Steam event? Because the game has some Lovecraft inspirations! As surprising as it may be for Nova Hearts, Lovecraft can take different forms and directions.

What is Lovecraft?
"H.P. Lovecraft (born August 20, 1890, Providence, Rhode Island, U.S.—died March 15, 1937, Providence) was an American author of fantastic and macabre short novels and stories, one of the 20th-century masters of the Gothic tale of terror. Lovecraft was interested in science from childhood, but lifelong poor health prevented him from attending college. He made his living as a ghostwriter and rewrite man and spent most of his life in seclusion and poverty. His fame as a writer increased after his death." H.P Lovecraft, The Editors of Encyclopaedia Britannica, www.britannica.com.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/a6b43251ecc83321e113ff7f7c62955757a9cf06.jpgThe Curious Case of H. P. Lovecraft, Paul Roland

The Lovecraftian themes in the game are: a cosmic mystery, the unknown/unknowable, an otherworldy influence on humanity, everything happening in a small town, and Fate.

In Nova Hearts, Sailor Moon is a clear visual influence on the game, but more subtly Lovecraft's artworks too! We wanted to pay homage to the author by adding our own sense of Lovecraft to the game. The entry point to that is exploring the horror of non-existence and the influence of otherworldly beings when they are deprived of human intention. The game has taken a softer point-of-view to match the joyful pop feel of a queer narrative based on magical girls but retained these notions of what lies hidden and the consequences of powers wielded without conscience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/e08cbb89a617d09511c357709916f858d1758e37.gif

Lovecraft's artworks are an important part of the game's story. Who are these enemies and "monsters", where are they coming from, and why are they here? This mystery is part of the fantasy we wanted to create. There was never supposed to be a horror tone on things, though, it's more this underlying element to build the whole setting, that would become clear at the end to make the stakes higher. In the first chapter Nova Hearts: The Spark, these enemies look cute on paper, but when you're facing them, you discover there is something wrong. There is a deeper meaning there and the why is what you will have to discover in the full game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/9661aa3bcf86bbdb18e0cf4ce627c4dedf51c7a5.png
Research for the "Chapter 1 Goon attack"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/08a0a42ffc7fa321ff92615c627a7ee5bb484a59.png
Final asset "Chapter 1 Goon attack"

More to discover about why the game has some Lovecraft inspirations in the full game! We can't be too explicit about it yet as we don't want to spoil anything! We can't wait for you to play Nova Hearts and discover it by yourself to understand where we're going with it!

Not convinced yet? Play the first chapter for free on our Steam page! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/06ce244d98736cc3cfeba631e8ba55757f5e97fc.png

notes.title: Why turn based combat and how does it work?
notes.content:
We're participating in the Turn Based Thursday Festival! What better than to talk a little bit about the combat of Nova Hearts? You were many to give your feedback on it and we took notes, so thank you! Let's dive into it and reply to some questions we've seen online.

Why mixing combat and visual novel/dating sim?
Our idea with Nova Hearts was to revisit the genres of visual novels and dating simulations. These games don't often have a combat system implemented. They are mostly based on narration, we wanted to spice it up and add some action into the mix! One great example is Boyfriend Dungeon. We were inspired by the well-balanced relationship between its story, dating, and combat. There are not a ton of games to mix genres like this, so we wanted to do our own and make a game we really want to play: FIGHT and FLIRT!

The theme of our game also helps a lot. In Magical Girls the "magical" is regularly associated with defending someone or something. The heroes have superpowers to fight the great evil! Here our trio Luce, Will, and CJ are defending the city from an emerging threat. Combat was definitely necessary in our scenario, and that's also the best place for Sailor Moon-esk transformations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/afb09810fca6df238ee445b71d69c5c3240fa1a4.gif

How does the combat work?
At the start of the combat, you will see a timeline at the bottom of the screen. This timeline is separated into equal parts that represent a turn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/ba07b737daf5dcd8e4c1bed1e1d3902875d1c1bf.png
When it is your time to play, there is a white bar you can move, representing the casting time of an attack. The more you move the bar to the right, the later your attack will be cast according to the order represented by the faces of the characters. If the white bar doesn't appear, it means this action is instantaneous and doesn't need casting time like Luce's second attack to heal all the allies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/3f40d142d75b5d4451b3069b3a3562a223d85d75.gif

How to progress?
During a playthrough, you will unlock new powers per character and will be able to up them. The Power App on the phone is the main place to manage your powers. After each combat, you gain XP points filling a jauge. When you have cumulated enough points, you can improve your attacks. The advantages are often an increase in the damages, in the buff/debuff bonuses, etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/7cae5fd9be9d94aa1951b5748478f05aa4b3bf09.png

Why did we choose this system?
Turn-based games and the timeline are dear to our hearts. Our previous game, Othercide has the timeline too in its combat. We wanted to use this system appreciated by the players and adapt it to Nova Hearts. Our current timeline is not final and will evolve based on your feedback. So if you want to share your experience with the combat of Nova Hearts, we're all ears!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/c91b28831679aa5b6baddac8f59fb6bd6936310f.jpg
Othercide's timeline


We can't wait to listen to your feedback so if you didn't get the chance yet, play Nove Hearts: The Sparke for free on our Steam page!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/06ce244d98736cc3cfeba631e8ba55757f5e97fc.png

notes.title: First Chapter delayed
notes.content:
Dear players,

We would like to inform you that the free first chapter "Nova Hearts - The Spark" will be postponed from its initial launch on January 17, 2024. The release date is moved by a few days. The first chapter, downloadable for free, will be officially playable end of January.

One of our core values is to be transparent and to make honest communications. We want your game experience to be the best possible and believe that postponing its release is the best decision we can make.

We are sorry for the inconvenience and are pleased to see that so many of you are excited to play the game. We ask you for some patience and thank you for your understanding.

The Lightbulb Crew team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/3ab1952173aa6faf3e04d899b87079bbe91909b2.png
